verdict.rationale: CSC is a registered-agent and entity-management service that includes software products (CSCNavigator, APIs). Whether its source is openly licensed is therefore a fair question to ask. Nothing in the evidence mentions a public source repository or an open license; the docs describe only proprietary secure dashboards and APIs, and the probes found no public artifacts.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
